matrix_experiment.scope: Independent finite matrices; not self-consistent CP2K calculations

specific_gaps.al_cg_response: Resolve the PBE/PADE functional/potential shorthand from the original inputs
specific_gaps.compatibility: Recover all 100 per-case records, including failures and extended runs
specific_gaps.generalized_smearing: Verify smearing widths and orbital-space settings against original inputs
specific_gaps.motion: A single propagated step is not long-time energy-conservation evidence
specific_gaps.kpoint_symmetry: Only free-energy endpoints and the ROKS integrated-spin difference are recorded; pointwise density-difference norms and paired electron-number residuals are unavailable
specific_gaps.lattice_fft_application: Only five-repeat kernel/total medians and common iteration count are transcribed. Original temporary input/output paths are absent. No per-run distributions or uncertainty estimates. The comparison is gathered versus distributed FFT application in a Gamma-point GFN2 model, not FFT versus a conventional operator or a metallic acceleration benchmark.

release_gates: recover original electronic-structure evidence or replace it with explicitly new calculations
freeze a persistent, citable data release
